messages:
olivia: heads up — noticed a weird switchback today: traffic moved to soft-fail for a route even though only transient 503s from the upstream, and operators kept getting inundated in the inbox :confused:

dave: ugh. is this the new hysteresis logic? which signal fired — error-rate or latency spike?

olivia: looks like error-rate (5xx) > threshold, but the logic also counted ‘cache-miss ratio’ as a secondary signal. combo pushed it past the soft-fail gate. sequence: 503s -> sample-run for degrade -> soft-fail -> operator inbox.

chris: can we avoid noisy switchbacks from brief bursts? sounds like we need a min-duration on the degrade window + a decay factor. also operator inbox should aggregate related events, not one message per request.

sanjay: agree re: aggregation. proposal: require signal to persist for 60s OR a rolling 30s avg > thresh + one-time spike guard. also add a small hysteresis counter so we don't flip back/forth quickly.

kat: for console UX: show "why degraded" with the top 3 contributing signals and a small sparkline. operator should be able to mute (snooze) related alerts for X mins from the thread UI.

olivia: +1. operator snooze would reduce alert-fatigue. can we surface the policy that triggered and a sample request id? we currently log only a generic reason code.

chris: we should include a short reason code and a human-readable breadcrumb in the audit log. i.e. add fields: reason_code, contributor_signals, sample_request_ids. e.g.:
```json
policy_trigger: "soft_fail_v2"
reason_code: "5xx_and_cache_miss"
contributors: ["5xx_rate", "kv_miss"]
sample_id: "req_2026_4823_01"
```

sanjay: storage/retention note: if we dump full sample payloads into audit logs for every degrade, cost will explode. only store ids and a link to a sampled payload store (S3) at e.g. 1% sampling, with admin override for on-call to fetch full payload for 10 minutes.

olivia: nice. that solves cost vs debuggability. UI flow: operator clicks the audit item -> quick modal with summary + link to sampled payload. add a big CTA "Escalate / Mark benign / Create incident" so ops can take one action.

dave: minor API thing — internal decisioning service should expose `/v1/policy/evaluate?route=...&window=1m` that returns a compact decision blob used by the console and by the runtime for consistent reasons. fields should be strings, small.

chris: that endpoint should also return `stability_hint` like `hysteresis_remaining_seconds` and `revert_eta` when applicable. saves guesswork in the console.

deploy-bot: deploy started: update/soft-fail-hysteresis-params -> canary to 2% of routes at 15:24 UTC :rocket:

kat: one more UX ask — when a route is under soft-fail, add a tiny inline banner in the route page with the active policy and a "why did this happen" tooltip that expands into the 3-signal breakdown.

olivia: agreed. next steps: sanjay to propose concrete threshold math + sampling plan, chris to sketch the audit payload shape, dave to spec the evaluate API, kat will mock the compact banner and inbox snooze. i'll follow up with a short runbook paragraph for on-call.

sanjay: I'll drop a PR with math/params by EOD and include a playground link for simulating spikes.

chris: i'll start the audit schema doc and add cost estimates for sampling rates.

olivia: thanks all :thumbsup:
